Job Summary
CHILD SAFEGUARDING:
Level 3: The post holder will have contact with children and/or young people either frequently (e.g. once a week or more) or intensively (e.g. four days in one month or more or overnight) because they work country programs; or are visiting country programs; or because they are responsible for implementing the police checking/vetting process of staff.
ROLE PURPOSE:
We are seeking a motivated Software Development Intern to join our team. This role offers an excellent opportunity for individuals beginning their career in software development to gain practical, hands-on experience in application development, understand the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and contribute to real-world projects.
SCOPE OF ROLE:
Reports to: IT Coordinator- Application Development & Enterprise Solution
Indirect Report: N/A
Staff reporting to this post: None
Close working relationships: IT Team in Country Office
Budget Responsibilities: None
KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY:
Under the overall guidance of the IT Coordinator – Application Development & Enterprise Solutions, the Intern will be involved in the following key tasks to
learn, practice, and perform:
• Assist in designing, developing, documenting, and maintaining software applications.
• Contribute to front-end design and user interface development, ensuring a user-friendly experience.
• Collaborate with the development team to implement features and fixes.
• Participate in the full SDLC, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, and deployment.
• Write clean, maintainable code and documentation.
• Participate in code reviews and team discussions.
• Learn and apply coding best practices, development tools, and agile methodologies.
• Support knowledge transfer within the team.
BEHAVIOURS (Values in Practice)
Accountability:
• Holds self accountable for making decisions, managing resources efficiently, achieving and role modelling Save the Children values
• Holds the team and partners accountable to deliver on their responsibilities - giving them the freedom to deliver in the best way they see fit, providing the necessary development to improve performance and applying appropriate consequences when results are not achieved.
Ambition:
• Sets ambitious and challenging goals for themselves and their team, takes responsibility for their own personal development and encourages their team to do the same
• Widely shares their personal vision for Save the Children, engages and motivates others
• Future orientated, thinks strategically and on a global scale.
Collaboration:
• Builds and maintains effective relationships, with their team, colleagues, Members and external partners and supporters
• Values diversity, sees it as a source of competitive strength
• Approachable, good listener, easy to talk to.
Creativity:
• Develops and encourages new and innovative solutions
• Willing to take disciplined risks.
Integrity:
• Honest, encourages openness and transparency; demonstrates highest levels of integrity

Job Requirements
QUALIFICATIONS
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (Fresh Graduates are welcome)
EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS
Essential
No prior formal work experience
• The candidate should have foundational knowledge of application development
• Candidates who have some practical initiative as volunteer experience contributing to a tech-related project or personal projects (apps, websites, tools, prototypes) created independently or as part of academic coursework will be preferred.
• Basic understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC).
• Strong problem-solving, learning agility, and teamwork skills.
• Good self-starter with effective time management skills
• Strong skills in coordinating and collaborating with others
• Positive, solution-driven, respectful, and with a “can-do” attitude
• Good communication and interpersonal skills
Desireable
• Understanding of Software Engineering principles
• Familiarity with Laravel and Vue.js, including front-end component design
• Knowledge of databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL)
• Basic understanding of UI/UX principles and front-end design

The duties and responsibilities as set out above are not exhaustive and the role holder may be required to carry out additional duties within reasonableness of their level of skills and experience.
Equal Opportunities
The role holder is required to carry out the duties in accordance with the SCI Equal Opportunities and Diversity policies and procedures.
Child Safeguarding

title: MIS and Reporting Assistant
description:
Job Summary
Job Summary
The MIS and Reporting Assistant will support the management, consolidation, and reporting of project data for education and community programs under the Sustainable Goals Organization for Afghanistan (SGOA). The role focuses on ensuring accurate data entry, database maintenance, report preparation, and timely dissemination of program information to support monitoring, evaluation, and learning processes.
The Assistant will work closely with program staff, field teams, and the provincial M&E Officer to facilitate efficient data flow, maintain reporting standards, and contribute to evidence-based program decision-making.
Key Responsibilities
Data Management & MIS Support
Assist in the collection, entry, and consolidation of program data from field sites.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date databases for tracking key indicators, attendance, outputs, and outcomes.
Support the development and use of digital tools and templates for data collection and reporting.
Ensure proper documentation, filing, and storage of program and M&E records.
Reporting & Documentation
Prepare regular program reports, summaries, and dashboards under the guidance of the M&E Officer.
Support the drafting of success stories, case studies, and lessons learned for internal and donor reporting.
Ensure reports are accurate, timely, and meet organizational and donor requirements.
Assist in preparing data and materials for evaluations, assessments, and audits.
Field Coordination & Verification
Support field teams in data collection and submission processes.
Conduct basic verification of data quality, completeness, and consistency.
Assist in field visits for data validation, monitoring, and reporting support.
Provide technical guidance to field staff on proper data submission and record-keeping.
Capacity Building Support
Support M&E and program staff in understanding and using reporting templates, digital tools, and data entry systems.
Contribute to promoting a culture of data accuracy and learning within the program team.
Stakeholder Coordination
Collaborate with program staff, local authorities, and partner organizations for data sharing and reporting purposes.
Ensure alignment of reporting formats with organizational policies and donor requirements.
Safeguarding & Compliance
Support adherence to data protection, confidentiality, and child safeguarding standards in all reporting and record management activities.
Ensure ethical handling of sensitive information and compliance with organizational policies.

Job Requirements
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Monitoring & Evaluation, Education, Social Sciences, Information Management, or a related field.
Experience
Minimum of 1–3 years of experience in M&E, data management, or reporting support, preferably in education or community development programs.
Experience in supporting database management, reporting, or MIS systems is desirable.
Prior experience with NGOs, INGOs, or donor-funded projects is an advantage.
Technical Skills
Proficiency in MS Office applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Experience with digital data collection tools (e.g., KoboToolbox, ODK) and MIS systems.
Basic data analysis skills and ability to generate summaries, tables, and charts.
Familiarity with donor reporting standards and impact measurement frameworks.
Soft Skills
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Good organizational and time management skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with teams and follow instructions.
Good communication skills and basic report-writing ability.
Language Skills
Fluency in Dari and Pashto is required.
Working knowledge of English is preferred.
Other Requirements
Willingness and ability to travel to field locations for data collection and monitoring support.
Commitment to gender equality, inclusion, confidentiality, and SGOA’s mission.

Submission Guideline
Candidates who meet the above-mentioned criteria are invited to apply through the submission link provided below. Applicants are required to upload their updated CV and cover letter and ensure that all requested documents are clear and complete. Applications must be submitted no later than the close of business (COB) on the application deadline. Applications received after the deadline (COB) will not be accepted or considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next stage of the recruitment process. Qualified local candidates are strongly encouraged to apply and will be given priority consideration.
Email / Application Form: https://forms.gle/XTkgVsJSZcHmPvn38

title: آموزگار طراحی و توسعه وبسایت
description:
Role Summary
بنیاد آقاخان – افغانستان یکی از نهاد های شبکه توسعه یی آقاخان است. شبکه توسعه یی آقاخان گروهی از نهاد های توسعه بین‌المللی، خصوصی و غیرفرقه‌ای می باشد که برای بهبود شرایط زندگی و فرصت‌ها برای مردم در برخی از فقیرترین نقاط جهان در حال توسعه تلاش می‌کنند. نهاد‌های این شبکه دارای مأموریت‌های فردی هستند که از زمینه‌های صحت و تعلیم و تربیه گرفته تا معماری، توسعه روستایی و ارتقای شرکت‌ها و مؤسسات خصوصی را شامل می‌شود که به دنبال توانمندسازی جوامع و افراد، معمولاً در شرایط محروم، برای بهبود شرایط زندگی و فرصت‌ها هستند.
بنیاد آقاخان یک نهاد توسعه بین‌المللی غیر فرقه‌ای است که در سال ۱۹۶۷ توسط والا حضرت آقاخان تأسیس گردیده است. مأموریت آن توسعه و ترویج راه‌حل‌های خلاقانه برای مشکلاتی است که مانع توسعه اجتماعی عمدتاً در آسیا و شرق آفریقا می‌شوند. این نهاد که به عنوان یک بنیاد خصوصی و غیرانتفاعی تحت قانون سوئیس تأسیس شده است، و در ۱۹ کشور دفاتر مستقل دارد.
بنیاد آقا خان به دنبال ارائه راه‌حل‌های پایدار برای رسیدگی به مشکلات بلندمدت فقر، گرسنگی، بی‌سوادی و بیماری های صحی است. در افغانستان، AKF با جوامع روستایی در مناطق کوهستانی، دورافتاده یا مناطق فقیر از نظر منابع طبیعی همکاری می‌کند تا کیفیت زندگی را در زمینه‌های مدیریت منابع طبیعی، توسعه بازار، حکومتداری، تعلیم و تربیه و صحت بهبود بخشد.
اهداف وظیفه
شبکه، اداره اجرا می نماید و زمینه همکاری های تخنیکی با دولت افغانستان، دونر ها و همکاران محلی از اعتبار بسزایی برخوردار است .
هدف از این بست فراهم آوری زمینه آموزش های حرفوی ومسلکی و تقویت نیروی انسانی ماهر ومسلکی به منظور رشد اشتغالزایی کسب وکارو افزایش سطح درآمد خانواده های میباشد. به همین منظور بخش اقتصاد فراگیر دفتر بنیاد آقاخان در جستجوی افراد علاقه مند در بخش آموزگار طراحی و توسعه وبسایت در ساحه فیض‌آباد، تحت پروژه تاب آوری اقتصاد فراگیر میباشد. ﺑﺧش اﻗﺗﺻﺎد ﻓراﮔﯾر ﺑﻧﯾﺎدآﻗﺎﺧﺎن ﺑﺎھﻣﮑﺎری اداره ﺗﻌﻠﯾﻣﺎت ﺗﺧﻧﯾﮑﯽ و ﻣﺳﻠﮑﯽ، اﯾن اداره از ﺟﻣﻠﮫ ﻧظﺎم آﻣوزﺷﯽ در ﮐﺷور اﺳت ﮐﮫ ﺑﺎھدف ﺗرﺑﯾت ﻧﯾروی اﻧﺳﺎﻧﯽ ﻣﺎھر و ﻣﺗﺧﺻص ﺑرای ﺑﺎزار ﮐﺎراﯾﺟﺎد ﮔردﯾده اﺳت.

Duties and Responsibilities
وظایف و مسؤلیت های کاری
· پلان‌گذاری، تنظیم و تطبیق برنامه‌های آموزشی نظری و عملی طراحی و توسعه وب مطابق نصاب و معیارهای آموزشی .
· تشریح تمام اجزایی طراحی و توسعه وب وظایف یا کاربرد آنها درطراحی و توسعه وب بصورت عملی و نظری برای تمام کارآموزان طراحی وتوسعه وب.
· وب سایت های و صفحات ها وب استندرد ، زیبا و واکنش گرا را با استفاده از HTMLو CSS طراحی و پیاده سازی نمایند.
· منطق تعاملات کاربرو رابطه های کاربری پویا را با Javascript و Reactتوسعه دهند.
· بخش Back endو وب اپلیکیشن ها را با Node.js ایجاد کرده و دیتابیس MongoDB را طراحی ، مدیریت و به سیستم متصل نمایند.
· یک وب اپلیکیشن کامل Full -Stack را از مرحله تحلیل و طراحی تا توسعه ،آزمایش و عیب یابی و را ه اندازی نمایند.
· آشنایی با مفاهیم اینترنت، وب و معماری وب ، تسلط بر طراحی رابط کاربری (UI) و بهبود تجربه کاربری (UX)..

· تهیه برنامه آموزشی مطابق با استانداردهای روز، گام‌به‌گام طراحی و توسعه وب از سطح مقدماتی تا پیشرفته.

شبکه، اداره اجرا می نماید و زمینه همکاری های تخنیکی با دولت افغانستان، دونر ها و همکاران محلی از اعتبار بسزایی برخوردار است .

· آشنایی با مفاهیم اینترنت، وب و معماری وب ، تسلط بر طراحی رابط کاربری (UI) و بهبود تجربه کاربری (UX). .

· رعایت و ترویج اصول صحت، مصونیت شغلی و حفاظت محیط کار در تمامی فعالیت‌های آموزشی و عملی .

· تهیه پلان‌های کاری، گزارش‌های روزانه، هفتگی و ماهوار و ارائه آن به مسئول مربوطه در سطح ولسوالی.
· انجام سایر وظایف مرتبط که از سوی آمر مربوطه مطابق اهداف و مقررات مرکز آموزشی سپرده می‌شود.

· گزارش هرگونه شک یا تخلف واقعی از پالیسی محافظت و/یا پالیسی محافظت از کودکان طبق آموزش‌های داده شده.

رعایت قوانین و پالیسی دفتر در تمام امورات کاری و داشتن تعهد به رعایت قوانین و پالیسی.

Ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory security requirements.
Implement secure access control for internal, external, and partner connectivity.

title: Information Management Officer (Beneficiary Data), (NO-2), FT, #00118138, Kabul - Afghanistan, APRO (For nationals of Afghanistan only)
description:
Job Summary
The fundamental mission of UNICEF is to promote the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything the organization does — in programs, in advocacy and in operations. The past two decades have seen important progress on child rights, yet while much has been achieved, sharp disparities remain. In most countries, inequality is higher today than a generation ago, including in middle -income countries where a majority of the world’s poor children now live. The rapid pace of urbanization and the growing youth bulge in Africa and parts of Asia will require significant expansion of the provision of essential services for children. These challenges are compounded by the scale and complexity of crises triggered by conflict, natural disasters or epidemics. The global community faces these challenges when the political and economic environments pose challenges of their own, testing the world’s commitment to protecting the most vulnerable. In this environment, strong and consistent leadership of UNICEF is critical to enable the achievement of results for children.
Job Organizational Context
The situation in Afghanistan remains exceptionally complex, with a protracted emergency situation, characterized by recurrent natural disasters, an increased number of people living in poverty, continued internal displacement, unprecedented levels of food insecurity, further compounded by the COVID-19 pandemic. This complexity has greatly impacted the situation of children and women in the country. The withdrawal of United States military forces from Afghanistan in August 2021 and the establishment of a de-facto government by the Taliban has exacerbated the complexity and uncertainty of the situation. UNICEF is required to rapidly adapt our ways of working to address the multiple operational constraints present in the highly volatile and unpredictable context. This includes the need to establish a Programme Management Unit that will provide operational and transactional capacity to the Afghanistan Country Office to ensure urgent lifesaving and resilience building programmes can continue.
The Project Management Unit (PMU), through its Cash and Incentives Team and Beneficiary Data Management Team, supports the nationwide implementation of several types of cash transfer programmes, including:
Monthly incentive payments for frontline service providers, including teachers and Polio Front Line Workers;
• Humanitarian Cash Transfer programmes, such as the Mother and Child Cash Transfer programme and Winterization assistance; and
• Ad hoc cash transfer interventions developed in response to the programming needs of the Afghanistan Country Office’s Programme Sections.
The Beneficiary Data Management Team provides information management, and systems support to facilitate effective programme operations, strengthen data management processes, and promote evidence-based decision-making across the PMU and Programme Sections.
Purpose for the Job
The Project Management Unit’s Information Management Officer (Beneficiary Data) will be based in Kabul and report directly to the Programme Specialist (Beneficiary Data). The incumbent will support the PMU Beneficiary Data Management Team in delivering effective and secure beneficiary data management services.
The position will contribute to the implementation of Humanitarian Cash Transfer and Incentive Payment projects through partner capacity-building, beneficiary data processing and management, and the administration of relevant information systems.
The Information Management Officer will work closely with the PMU and Programme Sections across the Afghanistan Country Office and, where required, coordinate with ACO Field Offices and other relevant stakeholders. This position will contribute directly to UNICEF’s transformative work by:
• Ensuring the effective, accurate, and secure management of beneficiary data;
• Supporting beneficiary registration, verification, data cleaning, payment preparation, reconciliation, and monitoring;
• Strengthening partners’ capacity to implement beneficiary data management processes;
• Supporting project information management, analysis, reporting, and dashboard development;
• Contributing to the administration, maintenance, and improvement of information management systems; and
• Supporting the Programme Specialist (Beneficiary Data) and acting on their behalf when required at the duty station.
In carrying out the work defined in this assignment, the IMO (Beneficiary Data) will ensure full compliance with UNICEF’s Data Protection Policy, security requirements, data quality, and actionable insights to support the effectiveness and efficiency in the team.
Summary of K ey F unctions/Accountabilities:
Under the direct supervision of the Programme Specialist (Beneficiary Data), the Information Management Officer (Beneficiary Data) [NO-B] will perform the following key functions and accountabilities:
1. Provide direct support to Partners and UNICEF users of data systems
1.1. Train Implementing Partners and UNICEF users to perform their respective roles and
functions in relevant data systems, including HOPE, InForm, Kobo, and other applicable platforms.
1.2. Provide first-level support in response to user questions, incidents, and technical support requests.
1.3. Assess and prioritize user support requests and escalate complex or high-priority cases to the Beneficiary Data Specialist for consideration and follow-up.
1.4. Ensure that all tasks performed within the relevant data systems meet established quality standards and are completed accurately and on time.
1.5. Maintain an updated list of Afghanistan Country Office users, roles, and access rights across relevant data systems, and facilitate the required review and endorsement by ACO management.
2. Third-party monitoring and beneficiary registration
2.1. Support the design of third-party verification exercises when existing beneficiary lists are received from external sources.
2.2. Provide oversight and technical support to beneficiary registration exercises, including testing registration questionnaires, supporting field piloting, and accompanying partner enumerators where required.
2.3. Conduct regular data quality assessments, identify bottlenecks and weaknesses in registration and verification processes, and propose appropriate corrective actions.
3. Beneficiary data processing
3.1. Implement targeting methodologies developed by the relevant ACO Programme Sections and conduct accuracy and consistency checks on the resulting target populations.
3.2. Support users of relevant data systems in preparing target populations, cash plans, and other required programme datasets.
3.3. Support users in designing and preparing payment verification exercises and coordinate data collection with Third-Party Monitors, Implementing Partners, SBC/CFM teams, and other relevant stakeholders through RapidPro, HOPE, Kobo, InForm, or field-based surveys.
4. Information management, analysis, and team support
4.1. Support the design, development, and regular updating of data visualizations and dashboards in Power BI.
4.2. Conduct data analysis and prepare reports, summaries, and other information products to support programme monitoring, planning, reporting, and evidence-based decision-making.
4.3. Contributes to the optimization, standardization, and innovation of Data Team processes to improve operational efficiency, data quality, and service delivery.
4.4. Support the Programme Specialist (Beneficiary Data) in coordinating the Data Team’s activities and acting on their behalf at the duty station when required.
5. Data protection
5.1. Support the implementation of UNICEF’s data protection policies and requirements across all levels and among all partners using beneficiary data systems.
5.2. Support the preparation, review, and follow-up of Non-Disclosure Agreements with Financial Service Providers, Third-Party Monitors, Implementing Partners, and other relevant stakeholders.
5.3. Monitor the implementation of recommendations arising from Data Protection Impact Assessments and follow up on identified actions and risk mitigation measures.

Job Requirements
Minimum requirements:
Education : Bachelor or equivalent (First Level University Degree) in Information Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Social Science, or any other related field.
Work Experience : At least 2 years of relevant work experience in Information Communication Technology, Information Management, Beneficiary Data Management, Cash Transfer Programs, Data Protection, Management Information Systems, Data Analysis, Dashboard Development, Third Party Monitoring, Beneficiary Registration, Capacity Building and any other related fields.

description:
Role Summary
The IT Advisor serves as an independent advisor to the Board of Management and provides strategic guidance, oversight, and recommendations regarding the Bank's information technology environment. Assess whether IT activities are aligned with the Bank's strategic objectives.
Advise the Board of Management on technology-related matters and emerging risks.
Monitor compliance with Board-approved IT policies, procedures, and standards.
Evaluate the adequacy of management oversight over IT operations.

Review the effectiveness of IT risk management practices.
Assess technology-related risks affecting the Bank's operations.
Advise the Board on significant IT risks and mitigation measures.
Monitor risk indicators relating to cybersecurity, infrastructure, applications, and data management.
Evaluate the Bank's readiness to address technology disruptions and cyber threats.

Review cybersecurity controls and security governance practices.
Assess compliance with information security policies and regulatory requirements.
Monitor cybersecurity incidents and corrective actions.
Evaluate vulnerability assessment and penetration testing results.
Advise the Board on cybersecurity improvements and emerging threats.

Assess the adequacy of IT infrastructure, systems, and services.
Monitor system availability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
Evaluate change management, system implementation, and project governance practices.
Review major IT projects and provide recommendations to the Board.

Monitor compliance with Da Afghanistan Bank (DAB) regulations, directives, and guidelines relating to information technology and information security.
Review implementation of regulatory recommendations and audit findings.
Advise the Board regarding regulatory developments affecting technology operations.
6. Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
Review the effectiveness of business continuity and disaster recovery arrangements.
Assess disaster recovery testing results and corrective actions.
Evaluate the Bank's ability to maintain critical services during disruptions.
Provide recommendations for strengthening operational resilience.
7. Reporting to the Board of Management
Prepare independent reports for the Board of Management regarding:
IT governance effectiveness.
Information security and cybersecurity status.
Technology risks and mitigation measures.
IT operational performance.
Regulatory compliance status.
Significant technology incidents.
Progress of major IT projects.
Present findings, observations, and recommendations during Board meetings.
Escalate significant concerns requiring Board attention.

Provide independent advice on:
Digital transformation initiatives.
Core banking systems.
Information security programs.
Technology investments.
Outsourcing and vendor management.
Emerging technologies and innovation.
Support management and the Board in making informed technology decisions.

Review and provide independent advice on the procurement of IT hardware, software, licenses, subscriptions, cybersecurity solutions, network equipment, and technology-related services.
Participate in the evaluation and selection process of IT vendors, suppliers, and service providers to ensure transparency, value for money, and alignment with the Bank's strategic objectives.
Assess technical specifications, requirements, and procurement proposals prior to submission for approval.
Ensure that all IT procurements comply with the Bank's procurement policies, information security requirements, and applicable regulatory directives.
Review technology contracts, service-level agreements (SLAs), maintenance agreements, and licensing arrangements from a technical and governance perspective.
Provide recommendations to the Board of Management regarding major technology investments and procurements.
Monitor the implementation and delivery of procured IT solutions to ensure that the Bank receives the agreed products and services.
Advise management and the Board on technology standardization, vendor risks, system compatibility, scalability, and cost optimization.

Review and advise on all significant technology expenditures, including core banking systems, digital banking platforms, cybersecurity solutions, data center infrastructure, cloud services, and outsourced technology services.
